g.text: Candle (3301) and the real gateway (4000) up
A llama-swap model answered by llama-swap
cmd: just gateway-routing-check | pass: just candle-up prints 'candle-up: ready' and the gateway answers GET /v1/models 200 (started only if not already up)
cmd: just gateway-routing-check | pass: prints 'route candle-qwen3-0.6b: http=200 endpoint=169.254.1.2:3301 completion_tokens=<n>'
cmd: just gateway-routing-check | pass: prints 'route <model>: http=200 endpoint=169.254.1.2:8000' (SKIPPED, not passed, if the model is not already resident)
cmd: just gateway-routing-check | pass: prints 'PASS gateway-routing' and what the script started is stopped (just candle-down, just gateway-down)
